capability.title: Filterable Menu Catalog
capability.description: Interactive menu board: category tabs, multi-select dietary filter chips, a sort control, a live result count, an empty state and dish cards grouped under a category sub-heading with photograph, description, price, calories and optional badge.
useWhen: Guests must browse every dish and narrow it down by category, diet or price
avoidWhen: Only a few hand-picked dishes need to be shown, which the Seasonal Picks block already covers
